issuer: a licensing officer under the Traffic Act (Cap. 50.10)
note: Read 2026-11-03 in the Traffic Act (Cap. 50.10), 2022 Revised Edition, on Tuvalu's online legislation (the Attorney General's Office). S. 15(b): no licence to drive a private motor vehicle to anyone under seventeen (a motor cycle from sixteen); s. 17(1): a driving licence is valid for 1, 3 or 5 years 'as specified on the licence'. That the three are terms the holder chooses among is a reading, as Victoria's are. The Schedule (s. 29): an application for a new driving licence, including any test, A$2, the fee held for each term (it doesn't vary by term); renewal A$1, a provisional licence A$1. The Schedule names the application 'under section 19', which in this edition is the section on visitors' foreign licences: its numbering is older than the Act's, and the item is read as the new licence's fee. The Minister may amend the Schedule by notice (s. 29(3)); no amending notice was found among the site's listings, so a later fee may stand. No identity card and no exchange list were read.
